description: Bounded, input-free capture: the same local level as safe-mode-smoke, but nobody touches the keyboard, so the event sequence comes from the fixture and the physics rather than from a hand. The window opens at level_started and closes after timing.window.max_frames frames, which makes the per-frame hook counts equal by construction instead of by luck. Runs on Geode 5.11.2 per runtime_baseline; `baseline` names the static analysis reference (the release was analysed against 5.6.1 bindings) and is descriptive only - the gate never compares it. See notes/deterministic-capture.md.

level.notes: Same generated fixture as safe-mode-smoke; no user or online level. sha256 is the digest of the level string the observer records at level_started - observed on 2026-10-27 to be the encoded k4 text, not the decoded object string. It does not hash the .gmd file. See notes/gd-save-format.md.

profile.notes: Use a disposable Windows profile or VM; restore from a snapshot. Do not run against a live player profile.

input.notes: No input injection exists in this harness, and this scenario deliberately needs none: the operator launches the level, touches nothing, and quits when the capture window closes. `actions` is empty because the events of interest are the fixture's own - a run into the first block, a death, a restart.

timing.notes: The observer enforces the window: it opens at level_started, writes 600 frames, then stops writing and records end.status=completed with end.frames=600. Records before level_started (menu navigation) are dropped, because the engine's frame counter is absolute since launch and the pre-level offset varies by tens of thousands of frames between runs. stop_on is refused inside a window: stopping on a milestone would make the window's length depend on the run. timeout_ms remains the operator's instruction.

optional.note: pushButton: not required here. An in-level jump would need injected input, and the pre-level menu clicks are exactly the variance the window drops, so requiring it would make the scenario demand the thing it is designed to remove.
savePercentage: the release vetoes this through Safe Mode and this fixture does not reach a completion, so it stays optional. See notes/safe-mode-feature.md.
